theorems.name: Submission.pcoarea_chart_pointwise_jacobian
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target → (∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u) → (∀ (A : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (Γ : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m) (T : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)) (E : Rn k →ₗ[ℝ] Rn (m + k)), Function.Bijective T → (∀ v, (T v).fst = Γ v) → (∀ z, T (E z) = WithLp.toLp 2 (0, z)) → (A ∘ₗ E).normDet * T.normDet = (A ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ).normDet) → ∀ u ∈ Φ.source, ((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) (Φ u)).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet * (fderiv ℝ Φ u).toLinearMap.normDet = ((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).normDet
